title: Compound Component: Tabs
prompt:
Build a `Tabs` component using the compound-component pattern. **Requirements:** 1. Import `createContext`, `useContext`, `useState`, `ReactNode` from `react`. 2. Create an internal `TabsContext` with `{ active: string; setActive: (id: string) => void }`. 3. Export three components: - `Tabs({ defaultActive, children })` -- manages state and renders a provider. - `TabList({ children })` -- renders `
{children}
`. - `TabPanel({ id, children })` -- renders `{children}` only when `active === id`. - `TabTrigger({ id, children })` -- a button that sets the active tab on click. 4. Callers compose like this: ```tsx A B A content B content ```
hints: A single shared context is enough -- each subcomponent reads what it needs.
Throw in `useTabsContext` so misuse is surfaced at the call site.
Use `aria-selected` on triggers to keep the pattern accessible.
